events.title: Dark Age Dinos is Coming to Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: It’s time, dino fans!A new (and final) Dark Age Dinos demo is coming to Steam Next Fest Oct 19th. The game has changed so much with your feedback that it’s hard to even list it all! We’ll try anyway.The TavernThe new character screen gives your party a classic starting point while providing 500% more dinosaur. We did the math.New MapThe map of Cretacia is more mysterious. events.title: Faces & Flora
events.summary: Spring has sprung dino fans! Another season, another demo update. The full game has had a surge of progress this year and we're happy to be sharing some of the improvements with our little demo community. First, we've added hand-drawn facial animations for every character in the game. Look forward to your favourite dinosaurs wincing in pain and cheering in triumph.Second, our Fight maps have undergone a significant overhaul. events.title: Reconnect Demo Update
events.summary: Hey Dark Age Dino fans! We come to deliver another demo update. What better way to kick back and relax over the holidays than bundled up with your favourite Dinosaurs? We've heard your cries of despair as your runs were dashed by internet outages. We've seen you have to end a run early because real life needs your attention. Well...no more! events.title: Dark Age Dinos - Summer Update
events.summary: Hey Dark Age Dinos lovers!We've got another small update to the demo to tide you over for the summer.Rewards are now delivered via shiny chestsAll spell and impact VFX have been improvedYou'll leave evidence of your carnageThe map has been spruced up to show some full release points of interestAnd of course, additional bug fixesDon't forget to share your feedback with us via the Feedback button in game. Dark Age Dinos can only reach its full potential with help from players, like yourselves!

events.title: Dark Age Dinos - Spring Update

Once again this update is just too large to give an exhaustive list, but here are some of the headlines: Cretacia’s shopkeepers got an extra large order of healing flasks recently and they’re practically giving them away. events.title: Demo V0.4 Is Live Now!
events.summary: Hey Dark Age Dinos fans! The v0.4 demo update goes live TODAY! Our team has been loving hearing all of your feedback since our Demo launched in August.
